set.body: Goal: make ScalaFIM semantically rich and valid-by-construction across the module graph, accepting broad API churn because the library is not in external use. Scope is the read-only 20-module audit from 2026-07-06. Strategy: add small validated boundary types, capability ADTs, and structured errors; keep hot numeric kernels primitive and direct; verify changed slices on JVM and JS. Acceptance: child motes cover every live module or cross-module dependency; downstream compile/test breakage from type hardening is treated as in-scope follow-up, not a reason to avoid the change.
set.title: Typed-core hardening roadmap
